Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. ⭐CANDIED CRANBERRIES⭐ 🍒 Grandma Lillian’s Candied Cranberries (the OG way) Before they were renamed as “the viral cranberries”, they were and always will be grandma Lillian’s candied cranberries to us. This is Grandma Lillian’s original recipe, and it’s as simple as it is perfect. She usually made it with orange juice and prosecco, but any juice/soda will work too!  📝 Ingredients: • 1 bag of fresh cranberries • Apple cider • Sprite • Powdered sugar (organic if possible) 👩‍🍳 Instructions: 1️⃣ Wash and pat dry your cranberries, removing any soft ones. 2️⃣ In a medium bowl, pour in equal parts apple cider and sprite 3️⃣ Add the cranberries and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours. 4️⃣ Strain and move to a clean bowl. 5️⃣ Add a generous amount of powdered sugar and shake until each berry is coated. If they’re sticky, add a little more powdered sugar. 6️⃣ Preheat the oven to 200°F. 7️⃣ Bake for 5 minutes to help dry out the sugar coating. 8️⃣ Leave them on the counter for a few hours to finish drying 9️⃣ Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for 12 hours. They’re best served chilled. (They will be good for 4-5 days) ✨ Enjoy and let us know if you try it 💚 💡 Important Tips: • @Ocean Spray Inc. cranberries give the best texture and flavor. • Always taste your powdered sugar first. If it has cornstarch, it can leave a perfume-like taste. We use organic powdered sugar because it usually doesn’t have cornstarch #candiedcranberries #candied #cranberries #viral #holidays

Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

This Pepper Steak is a simple recipe that can made in under 1 hour for a weeknight dinner. Full recipe is posted below and on my blog (check bio) My cookbook, Let’s Get Into It, is currently on sale at its lowest price on Amazon!  Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Next, pour the sauce into the skillet, stir and simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. Then, toss the steak into the skillet and mix well until all ingredients are combined and the steak is reheated. Serve and enjoy.

Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. HOW TO 1. Mix filling ingredients. Press into an even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze about 1 hour, until firm enough to cut. 2. Cut into roughly 2-by-2-inch squares. 3. Coat in flour, then egg, then combined Doritos and panko, pressing crumbs onto all sides. 4. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden and hot inside—mine took about 1½ minutes per side. 5. Drain on a wire rack and serve with sweet chili sauce. FREEZER STASH: Freeze extra breaded squares until firm, then bag with parchment between layers. #recipe #crabrangoon #dinner #food #easyrecipe

The turkey maybe the centerpiece, but the Mac and cheese is what everybody is waiting for!🙂‍↕️🧀  Ingredients 🛒:  1 lb Cavatappi noodles  12 oz can of evaporated milk  16 oz of heavy cream  Freshly shredded cheese - 8 oz of Gouda - 8 oz of Sharp or Mild Cheddar - 4 oz of Mozzarella  - 8 oz of Colby Jack   1 stick of butter (salted or unsalted)  1/2 cup of All purpose flour  Cream cheese or sour cream (optional)  Mustard or mustard seeds (optional)  Seasonings 🧂:  1 tbsp black pepper  1 tbsp of Italian seasoning  1-2 tsp paprika (smoked or not)  1 tsp salt (adjust to taste)  2 tsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of onion powder  Instructions 📝:  1. Cook the pasta - Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.  -Drain and set aside. 2. Prepare your cheese - freshly shred all cheeses. - Mix them together in a large bowl. - Divide the cheese mixture in half. - Set aside. 3. Make the cheese sauce - Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. - Add your seasonings  - Add flour and whisk for about 3–5 minutes. - Pour in evaporated milk and heavy cream. Then whisk together.  - (Optional, add mustard or ground mustard) - (Optional, add 4 oz of sour cream or cream cheese)  -Stir until smooth and creamy. 4. Combine pasta and sauce - Add cooked pasta to your cheese sauce. - Stir until every noodle is coated. 5. Layer your mac and cheese - Add half of your macaroni mixture. - Sprinkle half of the remaining shredded cheese over it. - Add the rest of the macaroni. - Top with the rest of your cheese, paprika, and parsley  6. Bake -Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes. -Broil on high for approximately 2 minutes to get that beautiful golden, crispy cheese top. -Watch carefully so it doesn't burn! #thanksgivingrecipes #macandcheese #soulfood #holidaycooking #comfortfood
